# OWNER ADJUDICATION — RA-3C QA V2 substantive FINAL PASS; Phase C merge/CI scope GO (2026-11-12)

## Owner independently verified Phase B (exact candidate)
- **PR #47 FUNCTIONAL was Owner FINAL PASSED and actually MERGED**. GitHub main reread now **`61b88eb31d1dec668e7e05495b88fe2d8a5b25fe`**; PR #47 exact feature HEAD `e2f9466f06bb3e7afbaf2e55575562d9d6fb453e`, with merge commit ordered parents prior main `60dbe1e1acfc84ad0849e84f3abe3712ad8ebccd` + feature HEAD, identical merged feature tree. No production share/approval.
- Current QA PR #48 `48cd0052c0edfe09c0bc00791ecdd8e5f29888c2` remains Draft and **MUST NOT merge yet**.
- Source-frozen V2 `test_acceptance_v2.py` Git blob `43992a9084ee5f2c6bbd6f6b051a986da5c9a20c` remains identical to freeze `00655091ac06ede0a26233feb6ff75da9fe642bb`; frozen V1 test blob `92ab4b2ef743abc0388866a2054952e56ba14a41` and original 14 inputs unchanged. QA branch retains all 1560 prior blobs/modes.
- Owner personally parsed **both original Python3.11/3.13 V2 JUnit XML**: **118 collected, 64 primary +54 invalid-request denials, 0 FAIL/ERROR/SKIP/XFAIL** each. Full JUnit 2150 nodes: **2072 PASS /53 original V1 FAIL /25 existing host SKIP /0 ERROR** each. Original 53 are exactly V1 inadmissible input/Guard mismatch, *not* suppressed or called PASS. This is expected historical V1 RED, not an accepted CI green state.
- Owner fetched and visually inspected your separately generated 375px/1280px screenshots; original browser JSON pins exact `e2f9466f06bb3e7afbaf2e55575562d9d6fb453e`, all four views privacy font=12px above fold, no horizontal overflow, 18 citation clicks resolved and 0 observed page external requests. Source quote pins and negative guard checks have their own actual provenance. PR #47 four hosted real jobs 4/4 SUCCESS previously independently verified.

**Verdict:** `OWNER_RA3C_QA_V2_PHASE_B_SUBSTANTIVE_FINAL_PASS` on pinned feature SHA. This is **NOT** `PR48_FINAL_MERGE_PASS` because Phase C integration & four new hosted GREEN checks are pending. Business boundaries, 0/26 Gold and CUSTOMER_SHARE_NO_GO unchanged.

## NOW AUTHORIZED — Codex-1 Phase C implementation/integration (do not wait)
1. In your **own PR #48 worktree only**, `git fetch origin && git merge --no-edit origin/main` after verifying `origin/main=61b88eb31d1dec668e7e05495b88fe2d8a5b25fe`. No rebase/cherry-pick/force push. Preserve all accepted-main blobs/modes and original V1 evidence, and all frozen V2 test source/14-case-oracle/negative-control data. Stop if merge conflicts and report.
2. **Explicit superseded V1 historical test-selection adjudication — narrow Owner exception:** the exact frozen V1 test at `tests/reporting/test_ra3c_independent_acceptance.py` and original fixtures must remain **byte/Git-blob IDENTICAL and runnable on demand**, with historical 11/53 RED/JUnit unchanged. V1's original inadmissible positive requests have been formally superseded by Owner's versioned V2 positive+negative contract; they are not valid ongoing GREEN assertions. It is now permitted to modify ONLY pytest default test-selection configuration (e.g. one explicit, documented `--ignore=tests/reporting/test_ra3c_independent_acceptance.py` in `pyproject.toml` addopts) **so V1 is a named HISTORICAL executable replay, not part of current GREEN suite**. This is NOT a skip/xfail or rewrite of source; report default collected counts with the omission **plainly**, do not silently hide legacy RED. Maintain a separate **actual explicit** V1 replay command overriding addopts/ignore, preserving **11 PASS /53 FAIL /exit1** and the original SHA. Verify command can actually collect exactly 64, not 0 or 64 skips. If default selection and explicit original replay cannot coexist truthfully, STOP for Owner rather than weaken source.
3. Bring the **entire frozen V2 118 cases** into the *default* ordinary `pytest -q` testpaths=`tests` via a **minimal QA-only `tests/reporting/test_...v2.py` collection shim** that imports and exposes the exact frozen V2 functions/fixture without copying, mutating, monkeypatching or relabeling their business oracles. Pin imported V2 source/hashes and independent fixture references. Make external candidate/version/observation input deterministic and source-integrity-checked for hosted CI, without recomputing trusted pins from the candidate/attacker. Existing V2 adapter source fingerprints must still fail if reporting code changes; no frozen V2 source edit.
4. Re-run both Python versions: **(a)** default current full test suite with V2 118 actually collected and ALL current tests PASS except original approved existing host/container skips, **(b)** explicit V2-only 118 PASS, **(c)** V1 historical explicit 11 PASS /53 FAIL exit1, **(d)** all earlier frozen replays, diff/hash audit, and independent exact merged-main browser checks. Preserve the earlier V1 11/53 and 2072/53/25 run logs unmodified.
5. Run **4 genuinely new GitHub hosted CI jobs on exact final PR #48 HEAD against latest accepted main**: Python 3.11 /3.13, isolated HTTP, isolated browser. All **4/4 SUCCESS**, read actual original checkout logs, confirm test merge parents (new main + QA final SHA), source/QA V2 test collection and isolation negative exits; do not rely on inherited PR47 CI or a green status without test discovery proof.
6. Submit versioned `PHASE_C_SUPERSEDED_V1_TEST_SELECTION.md` with rationale, exact single-file config diff, original immutable V1 Git blob + explicit replay/JUnit RED, newly discovered V2 118 JUnit/CI, source SHA/merge-ref parents + final SHA and a *clear table showing historical 53 tests were not included in default green run*. Keep all new evidence in Codex1-exclusive QA docs. If needed, update original QA PR README **by append-only notes**; do not rewrite archival records, old SHA, V1 tests, original 14 inputs, frozen V2 test, source Guard or history.
7. Keep PR #48 Draft after submission; STOP for **a separate Owner `PR48_FINAL_PASS` and exact SHA merge**. Do not touch Codex2's new Issue #51 / RA3D Phase0.5 worktree. No live sites, real model, expenses, approval, real clients, share, deployment, or RA3D production. Human Gold remains 0/26 `QUALITY_GATE_NOT_EVALUABLE`.

**Critical governance:** explicitly disclosed test-suite version replacement != falsifying 53 historical failures. Any use of skip/xfail/rewritten V1, V2 weakened assertions, CI-only bypass that doesn't run 118, hidden frontend script side effects, or green claim without true 4 hosted success is **STOP / FAIL**.

Owner status: `PR47_MERGED / RA3C_QA_V2_PHASE_B_FINAL_PASS / PR48_PHASE_C_IMPLEMENTATION_GO / PR48_MERGE_NO_GO / RA3D_PRODUCTION_NO_GO`.
